scope.latest_user_instruction: Move R live artifacts into the existing repository archive; update report locations and commit. No additional test or model runs.

verdict: Declared mechanical steps, typed copying and scoped explanation repair are integrated. Model repair and undeclared semantics remain imperfect; full-surface gate is red (13/17).

implementation.ordinary_wait: Reuse canonical tool requirements with current-document/action ordering; explicit wait/read only; no authorization inference.
implementation.explanation_repair: Independent receipt-bound fields assembled by application; feedback targets explanation only; settled work not re-exposed.
implementation.typed_copy: Reuse one existing source-bound/version-checked edit for explicitly typed single-source JSON/table values; immutable exact JSON number lexemes; multiple fields to one file.
implementation.research_steps: Eligible declared single-source Research workflows reuse direct leaves and existing CodeMode lowering, wait plans, citations and submit gate.
related_deterministic_fixes: Clear navigation binding from explanation-only restore contract.
Use current document consistently in ordered completion checks and guidance.
Recognize 不运行测试 in existing copy admission.
Include Research sequence wait in existing query click plan.

Research still requires correct query intent, observed evidence and post-wait citations; not every click is automatically a result query.
